d.ko: 언제 어디서나 즐기는 리치 마작, ‘작혼’의 세계로 초대합니다!
d.en: Mahjong Soul is an online game that adopted the classic Japanese Mahjong gameplay. Here, you can hone your mahjong skills with players from worldwide or spend leisure time with friends, bond with various charismatic characters, and experience an abundance of unique stories.
